function: Learns BS transmit precoder, active-RIS phase shifts and amplification, plus transmit power and spectrum sharing, to maximize V2I uplink sum rate (p. 1, 7).
system: Multi-antenna BS (M antennas), single-antenna vehicles, active RIS of V elements on a vehicle window; frequency band not stated (p. 3, 4, 11).
method: Mixed-action deep RL: DDPG agent for continuous precoder and RIS, DQN agent for discrete power and spectrum; online reinforcement learning (p. 7).
data_channel: Own simulator: time-varying Rician channel with Doppler for BS-RIS, Rayleigh for V2I and V2V links; vehicles dropped by Poisson process; no dataset (p. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation in the same simulated highway; curves for varied RIS elements, vehicle speed, vehicle number, CSI error, amplification; no separate test scenario (p. 11-13).
baselines: Learned DDPG-DA and mixed-action greedy policy (MAGP); non-learned alternating optimization (AO) (p. 8, 9, 11).
metrics: Reward equal to V2I uplink sum rate (bits/s/Hz), convergence, loss, computation time (p. 11-14).
complexity: Order O(E(S^a H^a U^a + S^c H^c U^c + S^q A^q H^q U^q)) (p. 11); 20 episodes take 120 s, versus 160 s MAGP and 250 s DDPG-DA (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "the Rician model [35] is employed, considering the Doppler effect [23]"; Rayleigh for V2I and V2V links. Custom simulator; no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing set or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 13: "we examine the relationship between the rewards of V2I communication and episodes by varying the vehicle speed". Reward-versus-episode curves per condition; no trained model is tested in a new scenario, and no adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 11: "attained an average reward of approximately 13, 12, 11, 10.5 bits/s/Hz" for MAGP, MAGP-ICSI, AO and DDPG-DA, against 14 for the proposal; p. 8: "DDPG-DA extends the standard DDPG algorithm"; AO is the non-learned optimization (p. 9).
q4_support: p. 11: "the overall complexity is denoted by O(E(" with actor, critic and Q-network terms; p. 14: "the proposed algorithm takes approximately 120 seconds to solve the optimization problem".
q5_support: p. 11: "all the simulation parameters are described in Table II"; vehicles are dropped by a spatial Poisson process in a custom simulator. No code or data link, and no public channel dataset or measured data.
notes: Area 3: the DDPG agent sets the BS precoder and RIS phase and amplitude (p. 7); the DQN agent chooses power and spectrum sharing jointly, so it passes above_phy as a joint decision. Table II (p. 11) read from the page image: no carrier frequency. q3 judgment for the reviewer: DDPG-DA (DDPG with a discrete-action layer, called a conventional benchmark in the abstract) counted as the learned baseline; MAGP is a greedy-policy variant of the proposal and was not counted.
